title: KOTH/Oracle Integration
description: Connects tool outcomes to ELO ratings and Thompson Sampling for agent performance tracking. Links Oracle recommendations to actual selections and feeds win/loss signals back to the KOTH rating engine.

oracle_consulted.description: Was Oracle queried before this tool call? Required when koth block is present. When true, oracle_recommended_agent and oracle_recommendation_confidence must be populated.

oracle_recommended_agent.description: Oracle's top recommendation at call time via Thompson Sampling. Null if oracle not consulted. Format: agent type string (e.g., 'morphllm:code-editor', 'general-purpose', 'code-architect').

oracle_recommendation_confidence.description: Oracle's confidence score [0.0, 1.0] based on Beta distribution sampling. Null if oracle not consulted. Higher values indicate stronger historical performance and larger sample size.

agents_in_options.description: For AskUserQuestion agent-selection questions only: agent names appearing as selectable options. The selected agent gets a 'win' signal, unselected agents get 'loss' signals. Null for non-agent-selection tools. This field is the primary training data source for KOTH ELO updates (source_weights.ab_testing = 1.5x).

koth_domain.description: Optional subcategory routing for domain-specific ELO ratings. Maps to KOTH initial-seeding.yaml domain structure. When null, uses global rating pool.

outcome_signal.description: Set post-response by telemetry hook (<your-telemetry-ingestor> PostToolUse). Null at call time, populated after tool execution completes. 'pending' indicates deferred outcome (e.g., awaiting UAEF eval). This drives ELO rating updates via <your-elo-engine>.

question_type.description: For AskUserQuestion only: primary type of decision being asked. Used for intent classification and KOTH domain routing. Null for non-interactive tools.
